name: BenchLM
description: Aggregator that collects published benchmark scores from model cards, launch posts, benchmark leaderboards and OpenBench into one table of 400+ models and normalises them into category and overall rankings with 'Supported' versus 'Estimated' evidence labels. It runs no evaluations of its own, so numbers inherit whatever scaffold and settings the original source used; its value is breadth, source links per score, and freshness/saturation tagging of benchmarks.
notes: Release month is approximate: the domain registration began 2025-08-12 (hypestat.com/info/benchlm.ai) and the earliest blog posts in its RSS feed are dated 2025-08-22. Benchmark list from benchlm.ai/methodology 'Benchmarks by category' (weighted and display-only entries).
